description: Hand-authored Korean developer-documentation sanity benchmark. Relevance labels identify documentation pages, not exhaustive human judgments. This is not a paper-quality held-out evaluation.

modelManifest.pooling: max(log(1 + relu(logits)), sequence); exclude special token IDs
modelManifest.notice: Derived quantized weights; original upstream benchmark scores do not measure this artifact.

metrics: page-level binary relevance, duplicate chunks collapsed; top-50 chunk retrieval then top-10 pages
memoryNote: Whole process includes both indexes, runtime, cached dense vectors and report objects; not isolated per-model RAM.
